errors.text_span: reaching about 90.8 at a train size of 1000
errors.evidence: The description states that the XLM-R model reaches an accuracy of about 90.8 at a train size of 1000. However, the plot shows the data point for XLM-R at this train size is located at an accuracy of approximately 91.0.

The description fails to mention a key visual feature of the plot: that the line for the XLM-R model is consistently above the line for the mBERT model, indicating its superior performance across all training sizes shown.
